Name: 187th Mechanised Infantry Division
Details: The 187th was stationed along the Confederation-Suns border a the end of the Star League period, and was the most active unit in XXIV Corps. The few bandit raids along the border that encountered SLDF forces usually ran into the Lancers. Based on New Hessen, the Lancers played a shell game, moving brigades along the border, sometimes hitching rides with civilian transport to hide their movements. The constant moving tightened up brigade-level coordination at the expense of divisionlevel organization.
